stages.text: On the roll. The Captain-General makes serjeants, and only in the hall at Highward.
Sergeant Rook keeps the Watch's roll at the parade ground, and would put you on it.
Trusted. The Church swears its own once you stand high enough with it, and the Prior hears it.
Prior Halm can put your standing with the Gray Church on the record, at the priory.
Trusted with the forges. The Preceptor's oath is Aldous's to give, and only in the chapterhouse.
Aldous keeps the Ironbound's chapterhouse, and would trust you with the forges now.
Trusted with the road. The Companies swear their own, and Vane can swear you, in her own tent.
Captain Vane holds the Free Companies' road from her tent, and you have her ear.
Trusted with the Hall. The Covenant is sworn there too, and Wren is the one who hears it.
Keeper Wren decides who is trusted with the Keepers' Hall, and you have asked the right questions.
Trusted with Crown business. The Regent's hand is a rank, not a favour, and the chamber gives it.
The Regent trusts a few with Crown business, and does it in the chamber, in person.
